message: Thanks, Gerry. I was really interested by your notes on *Empire*; what was your take on Hardt & Negri's ideas about bio-power, surveillance, and the production of subjectivities, particularly in the way they were trying to update Foucault? I'm not quite so sure it's either one way or the other: I think Foucault showed that surveillance *does* work in deeply troubling ways. (I wrote a little bit about Hardt & Negri in the second part of [this essay](/weblog/2004/05/31/rsa-presentation.html).)
